## For n8n Cloud / a separate server

Use this **only** if n8n cannot run on the
machine that holds `tracker/`. Otherwise
import `ingest-nightly.json` instead — it
needs no new code and no public URL.

**This will not work until three things exist:**

1. `POST /api/ingest` and
   `GET /api/ingest/status` in `app.mjs`
   — not written yet, see N8N.md
2. A public URL for the tracker machine
   (Cloudflare Tunnel)
3. `INGEST_TOKEN` in `tracker/.env`, and a
   matching n8n **Header Auth** credential
   (`X-Ingest-Token`)

Set the URL in both HTTP nodes.
